reason: rustfmt indents a `where` clause's bounds one level under the item and breaks an associated type's value onto its own line ahead of the `where`. The emitter keeps the source's line breaks and derives indentation from bracket nesting, and a `where` clause opens no bracket, so its bounds keep the column the source gave them. This is the same divergence `functions.rs` carries, reached through the const-trait syntax rather than through a signature width.
